The expectation comes from harness-authored runbook bytes, never the FO's own command log, so the FO cannot green by writing its own citation. recordedGateExpectedActor is deleted tree-wide. The no-conn boundary is non-vacuous — the injected record parses as a genuinely valid FO-attributed cited resolution through gates.Read and still reds under human-gate-bypassed, proving a citation confers no authority. AC-3 asserts exit==2 exactly plus byte-identical entity and no lock residue; deleting the CLI guard drops the exit to 1 and the matrix catches it. Surface is 14 files / net +261 against 11±2 / +150±40, past both tolerances: product core landed at +72 against the seeded +70, docs came in UNDER declared, and the entire +88 overage is the grader and CLI test code AC-3 itself demands. No file outside the approved design. Three deferred/polish findings, no material finding.
